content.en: Industrial schemes in India primarily aim to address structural bottlenecks. Key objectives include promoting **Manufacturing Excellence**, enhancing **Global Competitiveness**, and facilitating **Ease of Doing Business**. These initiatives often leverage **Production Linked Incentives (PLI)** to attract investment and create employment.
